toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS: a form of address such as 'oom' before a name takes a small letter inside a sentence.
toegepas.fout: Form of address 'Oom' capitalised mid-sentence against the AWS.
toegepas.rede_keurder: AWS writes 'oom' before a name in lower case inside a sentence; this matches the other mid-sentence instances being corrected.

toegepas.voor: Skuur saam met die lyne in die hout
toegepas.na: Skuur met die lyne in die hout saam
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Saam met' means 'together with'; 'met ... saam' is the Afrikaans for working along the grain.
toegepas.fout: 'Saam met die lyne' reads as 'together with the lines' rather than along the grain.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Met die lyne saam' is the natural Afrikaans for working along the grain, and the meaning is unchanged.

toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Terugstaan' is a separable compound verb, so its past participle is written as one word.
toegepas.fout: Separable verb 'terugstaan' written as two words in the past participle.
toegepas.rede_keurder: The past participle of the separable verb 'terugstaan' is written as one word, 'teruggestaan'.

laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'Motorhuis' is the standard Afrikaans word; 'garage' is an accepted but borrowed form.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'Garage' is a standard Afrikaans word, so 'motorhuis' is only a lateral swap.

laat_vaar.voor: as jou ma sê dit is reg
laat_vaar.na: as jou ma sê dit is goed
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'Dit is reg' for permission echoes English 'it's alright'; 'dit is goed' is the natural Afrikaans.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'Dit is reg' for permission is ordinary spoken Afrikaans in dialogue; the swap is lateral and spends the speaker's voice.

laat_vaar.rede_vinder: The story is in the past, so the modal should be past tense to match.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'Wil' is acceptable because her wish still stands; changing the tense of a story is a lateral move.

laat_vaar.voor: Die spykers was die volgende moeilike ding.
laat_vaar.na: Die spykers was die volgende uitdaging.
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'Moeilike ding' is vague and wooden; 'uitdaging' says the same at Grade 6 level.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'Die volgende moeilike ding' is plain, natural narration for the story's simple voice; 'uitdaging' is merely different and more abstract.

laat_vaar.voor: reguit en diep in die hout gegaan
laat_vaar.na: reguit en diep in die hout ingegaan
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: Movement into something takes the separable verb 'ingaan' in Afrikaans.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'Diep in die hout gegaan' is correct Afrikaans, and 'in die hout ingegaan' only doubles the 'in' without reading better.
